thread:
Lin: Heads-up: after the microsegment firewall roll yesterday some prod GPU nodes in eu-west-1 failed prewarm and then failed kube-join, seeing 403s when fetching keystore tokens.
Omar: Confirmed. Starts ~09:12 UTC. Warm pool healthy in other regions but eu-west-1 warmup flatlines.
Priya: Paste from node-init:
```
2026-04-02T09:12:38Z node-init: fetch secret -> 403
url=https://vault.prod.internal/v1/secret/data/prod/keystore/node-token
policy=fw-tighten-2026-04-02
```
Zoe (security): We tightened firewall egress and also deployed a policy that limits keystore paths to infra/keystore/eu/* to reduce blast radius. Looks like nodes still attempt legacy path.
Lin: That mismatch means nodes can't decrypt model blobs so they never join GPU pool -> autoscaler keeps spinning nodes -> spot/on-demand churn. ops-bot flagged cost spike.
ops-bot: Cost alert: eu-west-1 GPU spend +95% vs baseline (09:30).
Omar: Short-term: can we allow legacy path during rollout or add a translation mapping at the proxy?
Priya: Quick hack: add a Vault policy exception for node bootstrap to permit legacy path for 30m and bind to agent SA. Command (dry-run):
```
vault policy write temp-bootstrap-allow - <<EOF
path "secret/data/prod/keystore/node-token" {
  capabilities = ["read"]
}
EOF
vault token create -policy=temp-bootstrap-allow -orphan -ttl=30m
```
Zoe (security): We'll need an emergency exception logged. Also audit-shipper was intentionally paused during the firewall rollout to avoid duplicate logs; that means audit coverage gap for the window unless we re-enable immediately.
Lin: Re-enable audit exporter now please. We need event trails for compliance.
Priya: Patching audit exporter in k8s:
```
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/audit-exporter
```
Priya: Temp token created and injected into infra/bootstrap-secret. Starting to see successful keystore fetches.
Omar: Nodes are joining warm pool slowly. Prewarm latency back to normal at ~09:52. Cost alert cleared at 10:05.
Zoe (security): Follow-ups: (1) add a firewall-rollout checklist item to validate service path mappings (artifact, keystore, metrics), (2) require audit-shipper unpause step to be acknowledged by security before/after rollout, (3) add an automated check that boot agents can fetch keystore path in a canary namespace.
Lin: I'll open PLT ticket PLT-7003 and assign owners. Documenting incident and mitigation.
ops-bot: Incident recorded INC-2026-0402-FW-KEYSTORE. Linked: PLT-7003.
